name: Matsuo Tomoyuki
source:
Tomoyuki lives alone, because he lost his mother at a young age and his father works overseas.

He is very insecure due to having feminine features, which is a reason his friends make fun of him. He wants to become more manly, so that people won't make fun of him anymore.
translation:
Tomoyuki lives alone, because he lost his mother at a young age and his father works overseas.

He is very insecure due to having feminine features, which is a reason his friends make fun of him. He wants to become more manly, so that people won't make fun of him anymore.
